meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 首行会打印 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,先登记目标与成功标准,建一份只追加的笔记和待办清单,并按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级;完成前要用 HTTP、终端、浏览器等真实渠道抓取证据。
howto.when: 只在被要求进入 ultrawork 模式、且对话里还没有这份指令时触发;触发后它接管整轮流程:分级、登记目标、开笔记、写计划。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式做这个改动,并抓真实运行证据

say.text: ultrawork 模式,先登记目标再开工

howto.what_en: With ultrawork mode on, Claude prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! first, registers a goal with success criteria, keeps an append-only notepad and todo list, and captures real-surface evidence before it calls work done.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation; Claude then takes over the run with its bootstrap steps and tier triage.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug for me.
say_en.note: First line will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode on this change and capture real run evidence.
say_en.note: Sets up goal, notepad, todos and evidence.

say_en.text: Start in ultrawork mode and register the goal first.
say_en.note: Goal states deliverables and success criteria.
